listings.title: Charizard
listings.subtitle: Base Set Unlimited #4
listings.notes: Centring 60/40 left to right, 55/45 top to bottom. Corners are sharp under the loupe; the top-left has the faintest white fleck, visible only at an angle. Holo surface is clean with no scratches across the flames. Strong eye appeal for the grade.

provenance.event: Sold at an AU card show

listings.title: Umbreon VMAX
listings.subtitle: Evolving Skies Alt Art #215
listings.notes: Centring is close to 50/50 on the front. No print lines across the night sky, which is where this card usually fails. Edges clean all round.

listings.title: Lugia
listings.subtitle: Neo Genesis 1st Edition #9
listings.notes: The usual Neo Genesis back-edge whitening is light here. Holo has the common factory swirl, not damage. Centring 65/35 left to right, which is what kept it from a 9.

listings.title: Rayquaza VMAX
listings.subtitle: Evolving Skies Alt Art #218
listings.notes: Sharp corners and a clean textured surface. Centring 55/45. A strong copy for the grade.

listings.title: Blastoise
listings.subtitle: Base Set Unlimited #2
listings.notes: Bright holo with very little scratching. Back has a small soft spot on the bottom edge that you have to look for.

listings.title: Gengar VMAX
listings.subtitle: Fusion Strike Alt Art #271
listings.notes: Clean surface and corners. Centring 55/45 top to bottom. Colours are deep purple with no fading.
